title: gnaphalium gnaphalodes
intro: Gnaphalium gnaphalodes, commonly known as the White Cudweed or Arctic Cudweed, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, helping to soothe wounds and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Gnaphalium gnaphalodes include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
